Location service graph (instance.ts; location-services.ts)
|
|-- Shared location capabilities
|   |-- Config / Agent / Model / Plugin / Permission
|   |-- FileSystem / Shell / Snapshot / ToolOutput
|   `-- Tool registry: plugin + MCP + code-mode capabilities and hooks
|       `-- snapshot(permissions): advertised definitions + execute
|
|-- SessionContext (session/context.ts)
|   |-- select -> Store.get + Agent + merged permissions -> Tool.snapshot
|   |-- instructions: built-ins / discovery / skills / MCP / references / entries
|   `-- load -> resolved model + SessionHistory -> active messages / initial text
|-- SessionModelRequest: baseTranscript + primary -> prepared request
|   `-- plugin hooks shape request; -> shared SessionModelTransport.bind
|-- SessionCompaction: estimate / compact / precompute
|   `-- context pressure, explicit control and overflow use this service
|
`-- SessionRunnerLLM implements SessionRunner (session/runner/llm.ts)
    |-- SessionStep.make(): captured dependencies and attempt operation
    |-- drain(sessionID): continuation loop
    |   |-- await plugin activation; settle stale compactions/tool calls
    |   |-- advanceToStep -> Inbox controls or eligible input promotion
    |   |   `-- no work: idle hook may admit input; otherwise Complete
    |   |-- -> Context.select/load + Compaction + ModelRequest.primary
    |   |   `-- agent step limit: disable calls but retain tool definitions
    |   `-- runStep -> attempt outcome: retry / recover / compact / continue / finish
    |       `-- retry refreshes context without promoting more input
    `-- SessionStep.attempt scope (session/runner/step.ts)
        |-- attempt-local publisher + snapshot capture + tool-fiber collection
        |-- -> LLMClient.stream(prepared.request, options)
        |   |-- consume through stream end, not just finish event
        |   `-- publisher -> Bus -> projected text/reasoning/usage/tool events
        |-- local tool call: publish Tool.Called, then fork scoped execution
        |   |-- -> prepared.executeTool -> selected Tool.Snapshot.execute
        |   |-- declines/cancelled questions remain control failures
        |   `-- -> ToolOutput.truncate -> publisher.toolExecution -> Bus
        `-- await tool settlement before final step events
            |-- user stop: cooperative cancellation, then interrupt remainder
            `-- daemon handoff can leave work unsettled for restart recovery
